DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの品にいたしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 生の魚は避けたいので、炙りの魚なら中まで火が通っていると思い選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 生もの回避のため炙りを加熱済みと考えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ayoko po ng hilaw na isda, kaya pinili ko ang seared fish sa pag-aakalang luto hanggang loob.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang luto ang seared fish upang iwasan ang hilaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 炙りという名前だけで、中まで加熱されているとは判断できません。調理方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi masasabi sa seared na pangalan lang na luto ang loob. Titiyakin ang pagluluto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表面だけの場合もあるのですね。まだ注文を決めず、候補の仕上がりを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文前に具体的な加熱状態の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Maaari po palang ibabaw lang. Hindi muna ako pipili; gusto kong malaman ang aktuwal na luto ng kandidato.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng tiyak na paliwanag sa luto bago umorder. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理担当へ確認します。生の魚以外にも、避けたい条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itatanong sa tagaluto. Bukod sa hilaw na isda, may iba pa pong gustong iwasan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まずは中まで加熱されている品を探しています。自分で炙りを全部同じ扱いにせず、具体的な品で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前で一括判断せず品ごとに確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Luto po hanggang loob ang hinahanap muna. Hindi ko ituturing na pareho lahat ng seared; partikular na putahe ang itatanong.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag magpasya sa pangalan lamang at tiyakin ang bawat putahe. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この二品の材料と仕上げについて説明します。食べられるかの最終判断はご自身でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang sangkap at luto ng dalawang ito. Kayo ang huling magpapasya kung makakain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞くと一品は希望と違いました。もう一品も材料を聞いてから決めたいので、まだ通さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一候補を外し残る品の材料確認まで保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ayon po sa paliwanag, hindi tugma ang isa. Gusto kong marinig ang sangkap ng natira bago magpasya kaya huwag munang ipasa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Alisin ang isang kandidato at ipagpaliban hanggang matiyak ang sangkap ng natira. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。候補の材料を確認する間、注文は確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige po. Hindi muna kumpirmado habang sinusuri ang sangkap.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 材料と加熱の説明を聞きました。自分の希望に合うと判断したこちらを一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料と加熱説明を基に選んだ一品を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Narinig ko na po ang sangkap at luto. Itong napagpasiyahan kong tugma sa gusto ko, isa po.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Umorder ng isang pinili batay sa paliwanag ng sangkap at luto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちら一つですね。確認した品だけ注文を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Isa nito, tama? Ang natiyak na putahe lang ang tatanggapin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設の目的を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pakisabi ang layunin ng pagbubukas ng account.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父の生活費を管理したいです。私が手続きに来たので、父の名前で作って私が使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父名義の口座を自分が開設利用したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong pamahalaan ang gastusin ng tatay ko. Ako po ang pumunta; puwede bang sa pangalan niya at ako ang gagamit?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa sariling pagbukas at paggamit ng account sa pangalan ng ama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込者、名義人、利用する方を分けて確認する必要があります。お父様の申込みか、ご自身の申込みかを整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailangang ihiwalay ang applicant, account holder at user. Linawin kung aplikasyon ng ama o ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父の名義なら私の口座と同じには扱えませんね。父の手続きを代理で済ませられると考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込者と名義人の違いを認め代理を想定したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko po matutulad sa sarili kong account kung sa pangalan niya. Akala ko kaya kong tapusin bilang kinatawan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kilalanin ang applicant at account holder at ipaliwanag ang planong kinatawan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 代理の可否や必要な確認は担当が案内します。お父様は本日の来店についてご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ituturo ang pagiging kinatawan at kailangang pagtiyak. Alam po ba ng ama ang pagpunta ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談に来ることは伝えていますが、申込内容を父と決めたわけではありません。今日は条件を聞くだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父は相談だけ了承し申込内容未定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nasabi ko po ang konsultasyon pero hindi pa namin itinakda ang application details. Kondisyon lang ang tatanungin ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing konsultasyon lang ang alam ng ama at hindi pa tiyak ang aplikasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の口座に父の名前を記入して進めることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige po. Huwag ilagay ang pangalan ng ama sa sarili ninyong account application para magpatuloy.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。自分名義の申込みへ父の情報を混ぜません。本人が相談する方法と必要な確認事項を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の申込に父の情報を混ぜず本人の相談方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Hindi ko ihahalo sa sariling aplikasyon ang impormasyon niya. Pakituro kung paano siya kukonsulta at ang kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ihalo ang impormasyon ng ama at itanong ang konsultasyon ng mismong tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。口座が作れることや、ご家族が利用できることをここでは確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ituturo ng staff. Hindi natin tinitiyak ngayon ang pagbubukas o paggamit ng pamilya.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を父へ伝え、名義と利用目的を整理してから本人の相談方法を選びます。今日は申込みを出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父と名義目的を整理し条件確認後に相談方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sasabihin ko po sa tatay ang paliwanag, aayusin ang pangalan at layunin saka pipili ng konsultasyon niya. Hindi ako mag-aapply ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ayusin sa ama ang pangalan at layunin bago piliin ang konsultasyon matapos malaman ang kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、相談方法をご案内します。ご家族の情報は必要な範囲で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ituturo ang paraan. Impormasyon ng pamilya ayon lamang sa kailangan ang titiyakin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの書類についてお尋ねですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 計算画面には戻る金額が出たのに、この紙には納付とあります。相殺して残りだけ払えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 還付画面と納付書を相殺できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: May refund amount sa calculation screen pero nakasulat na bayaran sa papel. Maaari bang ibawas at natira lang ang bayaran?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maibabawas ang refund screen sa payment slip. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの税目、対象期間、計算の状態を確認します。数字だけで差し引く判断はしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titiyakin ang tax type, panahon at calculation status ng bawat isa. Huwag magbawas batay lamang sa numero.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つを同じ手続きの金額だと思っていました。画面の印刷と納付の紙を別に見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの資料を別に提示して対象確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po pareho silang proseso. Pakitingnan nang hiwalay ang screen print at payment paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita nang hiwalay ang dalawang dokumento at hilinging tiyakin ang saklaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの画面は入力途中の結果ですね。申告を送信した状態かも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Resulta po itong habang nag-iinput pa. Tiyakin din kung naipadala ang deklarasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ送信していません。還付が確定したと扱わず、入力内容と紙の対象を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未送信と申告し還付確定とは扱わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa po. Hindi ko ituturing na tiyak ang refund; ipasusuri sa staff ang input at saklaw ng papel.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iulat na hindi pa naipadala at huwag ituring na tiyak ang refund. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 納付の紙の期限も残していますか。確認が済むまで、期限がなくなったとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Nasa inyo rin ang deadline ng papel? Huwag isiping nawala ang deadline habang wala pang pagtiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙はそのままあります。期限を見て、今日の確認で解決しなければ必要な相談先と手順を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 納付期限を保持し未解決時の相談手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nasa akin po ang papel. Titingnan ang deadline at kung hindi malutas ngayon, itatanong ang tamang tanggapan at hakbang.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang deadline at itanong ang hakbang kung hindi malutas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ二つの資料をお渡しください。対応する税目と期間から整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ibigay sa staff ang dalawa. Aayusin ayon sa tax type at panahon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分で差額を書き込まず、資料の対象と申告状況を確認してから支払いの要否を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差額を自己記入せず税目期間と申告状態を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hindi ako sariling magsusulat ng diperensiya; titiyakin ang saklaw at filing status bago itanong kung kailangang magbayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag sariling isulat ang diperensiya at ayusin ang tax type, panahon at filing status. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当が確認します。入力途中の画面であることも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin ng staff. Sabihin ding input in progress ang screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの札は、展示用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pang-exhibit po ang label na iyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名刺くらいの大きさなので、作品紹介の持ち帰りカードだと思いました。まだ取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小札を持ち帰りカードと思い未接触だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Kasinglaki po ng business card kaya akala ko take-home artwork card. Hindi ko pa kinukuha.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang take-home card ang maliit na label at hindi pa nahawakan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作品を識別する展示札です。持ち帰れる案内は受付で別にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Pangkilala sa likha ang exhibit label. May hiwalay na take-home guide sa reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 展示の一部でしたか。位置を変えず、作品名だけ手元のメモへ書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示札を動かさず文字メモできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bahagi po pala ng exhibit. Maaari bang isulat sa memo ang pangalan nang hindi ginagalaw?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Huwag ilipat ang label at itanong kung maaaring itala ang teksto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メモはできます。撮影や複製については、展示ごとの案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Puwedeng magtala. Sa larawan at reproduksiyon, tingnan ang bawat exhibit guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 札を持って写真に入れることはしません。あとで作品を問い合わせたいので、作家名と作品名を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 札を撮影小物にせず作家名作品名を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po hahawakan ang label para isama sa larawan. Itatala ang artist at artwork para maitanong sa huli.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag gawing photo prop ang label at itala ang artist at likha. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 問い合わせには作品番号も役立ちます。受付で案内できる内容は確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Makatutulong din ang artwork number. Titiyakin kung ano ang maituturo sa reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号も追加します。札にある数字を販売価格と決めつけず、作品の識別番号として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作品番号を価格と区別して控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Idaragdag ko po ang numero. Hindi ko ituturing na presyo ang numero; identification ang sasabihin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itala ang artwork number nang hiwalay sa presyo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。持ち帰り資料をご希望なら、受付へお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Kung kailangan ng take-home materials, magsabi sa reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この三つを控えました。札には触れず、受付で資料の有無と問い合わせ方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札に触れず資料と問い合わせ方法を受付で聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naitala ko po ang tatlo. Hindi hahawakan ang label at itatanong sa reception ang materyales at paraan ng inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag hawakan ang label at itanong sa reception ang materyales at inquiry. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では受付へどうぞ。展示札はそのままご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sa reception po. Iwan ang exhibit label habang tumitingin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬の説明を始めます。気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sisimulan ang paliwanag ng gamot. May tanong po?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋がたくさんあるので、薬の種類が前より増えたと思いました。全部違う薬ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装袋数を薬の種類増加と考えた疑問を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Maraming supot kaya akala ko dumami ang uri kaysa dati. Lahat po ba ay ibang gamot?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pag-aakalang mas maraming uri dahil maraming supot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の数と薬の種類数は別です。包装方法と処方の内容を薬剤師が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang bilang ng supot at uri. Ipapaliwanag ng pharmacist ang packaging at reseta.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋一つを一種類と数えていました。中身を自分で出す前に、今回の薬の一覧を見て説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋を開けず今回の薬一覧で説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bawat supot po ay binilang kong isang uri. Bago ko ilabas ang laman, pakipaliwanag gamit ang listahan ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Huwag buksan ang supot at humiling ng paliwanag sa kasalukuyang drug list. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬剤師が一覧と袋の表示を確認します。前回の情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng pharmacist ang listahan at label. May nakaraang impormasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お薬手帳があります。前回と今回を比べる時も、袋の見た目だけで変更を判断しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: お薬手帳を示し見た目だけで処方変更を判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: May medicine notebook po. Hindi ako sa hitsura lang magpapasya na may pagbabago kapag ikinumpara.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang medicine notebook at huwag magpasya sa pagbabago batay sa hitsura. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その手帳を薬剤師に見せてください。飲む時刻の表示も一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipakita sa pharmacist ang notebook. Titingnan din ang oras ng pag-inom.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 朝と夕方の表示があります。袋の数が多いから飲む回数を減らすことはせず、指示を聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋数を理由に服用回数を変えず時刻指示を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: May umaga at gabi. Hindi ko babawasan ang dalas dahil maraming supot; pakikinggan uli ang tagubilin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag baguhin ang dalas dahil sa dami ng supot at itanong ang oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。分からないまま飲み方を変えないでください。薬剤師から確認を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Huwag baguhin nang hindi malinaw; magpatiyak sa pharmacist.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手帳と今回の一覧を見せ、種類と飲む時刻を分けて確認します。理解できた内容を言い返して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種類と時刻を分け復唱確認をしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ipapakita ko po ang notebook at listahan ngayon at ihihiwalay ang uri at oras. Gusto kong ulitin ang naunawaan para matiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang uri at oras at humiling ng pagtiyak sa pag-uulit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 薬剤師を呼びます。袋は開けずにそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tatawagin ang pharmacist. Panatilihing hindi bukas ang mga supot.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱の中身は本でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Libro po ba ang laman ng kahon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本です。ただ、友人に返すお金を封筒に入れ、本の間に挟んであります。箱ごと普通に送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本の中の現金を申告し普通の荷物で出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Libro po, pero may sobre ng perang ibabalik sa kaibigan sa pagitan ng libro. Maaari bang ipadala bilang karaniwang kahon?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang cash sa libro at itanong ang karaniwang pagpapadala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現金が含まれる場合は、通常の荷物としてそのまま受け付けず、扱いを確認します。まだ封を閉じていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kung may cash, hindi basta tatanggapin bilang ordinaryong parcel; titiyakin ang paghawak. Hindi pa po selyado?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。本だけと言ったのは不正確でした。自分の箱を開けて現金の封筒を取り出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封緘と内容申告の不足を認め現金を外したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po. Hindi tumpak ang libro lang na sinabi ko. Bubuksan ko ang sarili kong kahon at ilalabas ang cash envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa selyado, aminin ang kulang na deklarasyon at nais alisin ang cash. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで中身を確認する方法を担当が案内します。現金を見えなくして、本だけと申し出直すことはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ituturo ng staff kung paano suriin. Huwag itago ang cash at sabihing libro lang muli.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隠すためではなく、別に保管するために取り出します。取り出した後の本と箱の状態も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隠蔽でなく別保管のためと説明し箱の再確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi po para itago kundi hiwalay na itabi. Gusto ko ring suriin ang libro at kahon pagkatapos alisin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hiwalay na itatabi, hindi itatago, at hilinging suriin muli ang kahon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当と確認しましょう。現金の封筒は、お客様ご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sabay tiyakin sa staff. Kayo mismo ang mag-ingat ng cash envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒は自分のバッグへ入れました。本の間にも残っていないことを、自分で一冊ずつ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金を自己管理し本に残っていないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nasa sariling bag ko na po. Isa-isang titingnan ang libro para walang natitira sa pagitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sariling ingatan ang cash at tiyaking walang natira sa libro. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現金を送る必要があるなら、別に対応方法をご案内します。本の発送はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung kailangang magpadala ng cash, may hiwalay na paraan. Ano po ang gagawin sa libro?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は本だけの発送方法を相談します。お金は持ち帰り、友人と返し方を決めてから別に対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本だけの発送を相談し現金は持ち帰って返し方を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Libro lang po ang itatanong ngayon. Iuuwi ang pera at magpapasya kami ng kaibigan kung paano ibabalik, saka hiwalay na gagawin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magtanong sa libro lamang, iuwi ang cash at magpasya ng pagbabalik. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、現金を外した箱の内容と、本に適した発送方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-CHUO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tiyakin natin ang kahong walang cash at angkop na book shipping.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの便をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約には駅前とあるので、この停留所で高速バスを待っています。行先が表示されません。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅名一致だけで待つ場所を決めたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nasa reservation po ay station front, kaya dito ko hinihintay ang highway bus. Walang destinasyong lumalabas.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing station name lamang ang batayan ng hintayan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ駅名の停留所が複数あります。予約に乗場の詳しい案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maraming stop na parehong estasyon. May detalyadong gabay ba sa reservation?

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールの下に南側の案内図がありました。今は北側なので、駅名だけで場所を決めていました。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約図の南北と現在地の不一致に気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.translation: May south-side map po pala sa ibaba ng email. Nasa north ako; pangalan lang ang pinagbatayan.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mapansin ang hindi tugma na north/south sa mapa at kasalukuyang lugar. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約の案内と現在地を照合しましょう。荷物を持って移動されますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itugma ang reservation at lokasyon. May dala pong bagahe sa paglipat?

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きなケースがあります。バスを追いかけるのでなく、南側へ通れる経路を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ケースを持って使える移動経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Malaking case po. Sa halip na habulin ang bus, gusto kong tiyakin ang daang papuntang south.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang rutang magagamit nang may case. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の通路案内を見てください。ここから車道を横切らず、駅の案内された通路を使います。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan ang daan ngayon. Huwag tumawid sa kalsada mula rito; gamitin ang itinurong station passage.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の入口から移動します。同行者もここへ向かっているので、今の待ち場所が違うと先に知らせます。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定通路を使い同行者へ場所訂正を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Doon po sa passage entrance ako lilipat. Papunta rin dito ang kasama; sasabihin ko munang mali ang hintayan ngayon.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Gamitin ang itinakdang daan at ipaalam ang pagwawasto sa kasama. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 南側に着いてからも、予約便の乗場表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagdating sa south, tiyakin pa rin ang stop sign ng biyahe ninyo.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。同行者へ南側の案内図を送り、到着後に便名と乗場を照合してから待ちます。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 到着後も便名と乗場を照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Ipapadala ang south map at pagdating, itutugma ang trip name at stop bago maghintay.
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing itutugma ang trip at sakayan kahit pagdating. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では案内された通路へどうぞ。駅名が同じでも乗場は分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-HACHIOJI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sundan ang itinurong daan. Kahit parehong station name, hiwalay na tiyakin ang stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その機械は乾燥専用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Dryer lamang po ang makinang iyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 洗濯機が空くまで、先にここで回してから洗えば時間を短くできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未洗濯の衣類を空き乾燥機で先に回せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Habang wala pang bakanteng washer, mapapaikli ba ang oras kung paandarin muna rito saka labhan?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maipapasok muna ang hindi labhang damit sa bakanteng dryer. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 洗濯と乾燥の用途を分けて確認してください。汚れた衣類を先に乾燥させる案内はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ihiwalay ang laundry at drying. Hindi namin itinuturo na patuyuin muna ang maruming damit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空いている機械から使えばよいと思っていました。まだ入れていません。洗濯できる機械を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入と伝え洗濯用途の機械を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po kung alin ang bakante, iyon muna. Hindi ko pa inilalagay; gusto kong tiyakin ang washer.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa nailalagay at hanapin ang washing machine. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが洗濯機です。衣類がこの機械の対象になるか、表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang washer. Tingnan rin kung sakop ng makina ang damit ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毛布もあります。服と同じ扱いにせず、毛布の表示と機械の対象を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毛布を服と分けタグと対象表示を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May kumot din po. Hindi ko itutulad sa damit; itutugma ang care tag at machine label.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang kumot at itugma ang tag at saklaw ng makina. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きさや素材で確認が必要です。表示が読めない物は、今ここで使えると判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin ang laki at materyal. Huwag magpasya na puwede ngayon kung hindi mabasa ang tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 毛布のタグが薄くて読めません。毛布は持ち帰り、表示が確認できた衣類だけで洗濯を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: タグ不読の毛布を除き確認可能な衣類だけ選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kupas po ang tag ng kumot. Iuuwi ang kumot at ang damit na natiyak lamang ang isasaalang-alang labhan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Alisin ang kumot na hindi mabasa ang tag at piliin ang matitiyak na damit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その衣類の量と機械の案内を確認してから選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Piliin matapos tingnan ang dami at machine guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。未洗濯の物を乾燥機へ入れず、対象が確認できた衣類で洗濯機を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先乾燥をやめ対象と量で洗濯機を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hindi muna ilalagay sa dryer ang hindi labha; pipili ng washer ayon sa natiyak na damit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itigil ang unang pagpapatuyo at pumili ng washer ayon sa saklaw at dami. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では洗濯機の案内を見ましょう。乾燥は洗濯後に別に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tingnan ang washer guide. Hiwalay na titiyakin ang drying pagkatapos.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: スープを濃いめで伺っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Mas matapang na sabaw po ang order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、麺を硬めにしたいと言ったつもりでした。スープの濃さは変える希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 麺硬さをスープ濃さの注文から訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mas matigas pong noodles sana ang sinabi ko. Hindi ko hiniling baguhin ang tapang ng sabaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itama ang tigas ng noodles mula sa order ng tapang ng sabaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 麺の仕上がりのご希望ですね。調理前か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Noodle finish pala. Titiyakin kung hindi pa niluluto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ変更できるかを聞いてからお願いしたいです。言い直しただけで調理が直ったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 調理状況を確認してから変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Gusto ko pong hilingin matapos malaman kung mababago pa. Hindi ko iisiping naitama ang pagluluto dahil sinabi ko lang muli.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais baguhin matapos matiyak ang pagluluto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では調理前でした。麺の硬さを担当へ伝え、スープは元の注文内容にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito hindi pa niluluto. Sasabihin ang tigas ng noodles at orihinal ang sabaw.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ほかの人の注文も濃いめへ変えないよう、私の一杯だけの訂正として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の一杯だけの訂正と指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap po. Akin lang ang itama para hindi mabago sa matapang ang order ng iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tukuying sariling isang bowl lang ang pagwawasto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: あなたの注文はこちらの一杯ですね。追加の麺は注文されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ito ang isang order ninyo. May dagdag na noodles na ba?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追加はしていません。硬めという希望は量を増やす意味でもないので、一杯の量は変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加麺はなく硬さ希望と量を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wala po. Hindi rin dagdag na dami ang matigas kaya hindi babaguhin ang isang bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang dagdag na noodles at ihiwalay ang tigas at dami. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。麺の希望とスープ、量を分けて注文を読み返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Natiyak. Uulitin nang hiwalay ang noodles, sabaw at dami.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。麺は希望の仕上がり、スープは元の内容、追加なしの一杯でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 麺スープ量の復唱を確認して注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Noodles ayon sa gusto kong luto, orihinal na sabaw at isang bowl na walang dagdag, pakiusap.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pag-uulit ng noodles, sabaw at dami at umorder. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を担当へ伝えます。変更したのは麺の希望だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa sa tagaluto. Noodle preference lang ang nabago.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診で分からない項目はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族歴に、同居している友人の咳を書きました。同じ家に住む人の今の症状を書く欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族歴に同居友人の現症状を書いた疑問を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Isinulat ko po sa family history ang ubo ng kaibigan kong kasambahay. Para ba sa kasalukuyang sintomas ng mga kasama sa bahay ang field?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagsulat ng kasalukuyang sintomas ng kasambahay sa family history. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その欄の目的は診療担当が説明します。同居人の今の症状とは別に確認する内容があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Medical staff ang magpapaliwanag ng field. Hiwalay ang ibang kailangang tiyakin sa kasalukuyang sintomas ng kasambahay.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族という言葉を同じ住まいの人と読んでいました。自分の記入を見せて、適切な欄を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居と家族歴の意味を混同したと認め欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inunawa ko pong pamilya bilang parehong tirahan. Ipapakita ko ang sinulat at itatanong ang angkop na field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Aminin ang paghahalo ng cohabitation at family history at tiyakin ang field. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。ご自身の症状についても、分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itatanong sa staff. Ipaliwanag din nang hiwalay ang sarili ninyong sintomas.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分は昨日から咳があります。友人は先週からですが、その情報が自分の発症日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分と友人の症状開始時点を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ako po ay inuubo mula kahapon. Kaibigan ko mula noong nakaraang linggo; hindi iyon simula ng akin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang simula ng sariling sintomas at kaibigan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの時点と、誰から聞いた情報かも分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ihiwalay din ang bawat oras at kung kanino narinig.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人の時点は本人から聞いた話です。自分が毎日観察した記録ではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人情報は本人からの伝聞と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa kanya ko po narinig ang panahon. Sasabihin kong hindi iyon tala ng araw-araw kong pagmamasid.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na ang impormasyon ng kaibigan ay narinig mismo sa kanya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族歴の説明を受けてから、不明な部分を記入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige po. Matapos ang family history explanation, puwedeng sagutan ang hindi alam.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。血縁者の病歴で分からない所は推測せず、同居人の話と自分の症状を分けて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明病歴を推測せず三つの情報を担当へ分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Hindi huhulaan ang hindi alam na sakit ng kadugo, at hiwalay kong sasabihin ang kasambahay at sariling sintomas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag hulaan ang hindi alam at ihiwalay ang tatlong impormasyon sa staff. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を引き継ぎます。記入欄の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa ang mga iyon. Hintayin ang field explanation.
